name: Doppler
notes: Built from this pinned public source in the worker images (worker/Dockerfile.lean, worker/Dockerfile.full) and installed under /usr/lib/doppler, off PATH, as separate executables (the Poppler utilities, doppler-md, pdftomarkdown). The PDF extractor: in a VM (vm-pdf) or, customer-owned only, on the host (DOCSLURP_PDF_MODE=local). Never linked or vendored into core packages or the SDKs (GPL-2.0-or-later).
advisories: Doppler is a Poppler fork pinned to one commit; Debian's poppler-utils security patches do not reach it. Before each release, and at least monthly, check Poppler upstream security fixes (gitlab.freedesktop.org/poppler/poppler, Debian security tracker for src:poppler) against the fork's base and the DocSlurp/doppler advisories, rebase or cherry-pick, and move this pin (commit, source url and sha256). Tracked in TODO.md.
